violation_type.title: Installation of Unitary Surfacing Materials - Over Concrete or Asphalt (26 TAC §746.4911(b))
violation_type.short_title: Installation of Unitary Surfacing Materials - Over Concrete or Asphalt
violation_type.typical_finding: Two play slide equipments are over unitary surfacing that was installed over concrete.     Corrected:  When the operation removed the play equipment off the  unitary surfacing.

finding_variants.text: Two play slide equipments are over unitary surfacing that was installed over concrete.     Corrected:  When the operation removed the play equipment off the  unitary surfacing.

During the inspection it was found that there was an ABC mat, placed over concrete as unitary surfacing for a slide fall zone, however the manufacturer of this mat does not state that this is an appropriate unitary surfacing over concrete. This was corrected at inspection when the slides were removed from the infant playground.
